In addition, guests can choose between complimentary wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours or a shore excursion credit.

intro.heading: Understanding Oceania's Inclusion Formula
paragraphs: Oceania Cruises includes more in its standard cruise fare than many travelers initially expect. Through its Your World Included program, guests receive specialty dining, shipboard gratuities, complimentary Wi-Fi, selected nonalcoholic beverages, and laundry-related benefits. In addition, guests can choose between complimentary wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours or a shore excursion credit.

However, Oceania is not an entirely all-inclusive cruise line where every drink, excursion, spa treatment, and personal purchase is covered. Some experiences still cost extra, including premium alcoholic beverages, spa treatments, certain culinary experiences, excursions beyond the available credit, and optional travel arrangements such as flights and hotels.
Understanding the difference between standard inclusions and optional expenses can help you calculate the real cost of your cruise before booking.

gratuities.title: Are Gratuities Included on Oceania Cruises?
gratuities.subtitle: Prepaid crew gratuities under Your World Included and transparent onboard tipping guidelines
paragraphs: For bookings covered by the current Your World Included program, standard shipboard gratuities for covered service teams are included in the cruise fare. This provides significant value because guests do not need to calculate or budget a separate daily per-guest service fee.

The included shipboard gratuities cover stateroom attendants, suite attendants and butlers (where applicable), and dining waitstaff. However, a 20% service gratuity still applies to certain additional onboard purchases such as beverage packages and spa treatments.

Additional tipping remains an entirely personal decision. Standard covered gratuities are already paid in full within your fare, so extra cash tips are optional and reserved for exceptional personal service.

allInclusiveTruth.title: Is Oceania Cruises Really All-Inclusive?
paragraphs: Oceania is often described as an inclusive luxury cruise experience, but it is most accurately described as a luxury cruise line with a substantial set of included amenities and transparent optional extras.

The cruise fare covers the most significant day-to-day onboard costs: specialty dining with no cover charges, shipboard crew gratuities, Starlink Wi-Fi, nonalcoholic beverages, and laundry facilities. The Your World Included program gives guests the flexibility to choose either mealtime wine and beer or shore excursion credits.

However, travelers who expect 24/7 unlimited top-shelf open bar, complimentary spa treatments, or every single shore tour to be free will find that those items remain separate. For travelers who prioritize dining excellence and destination depth without paying for unused perks, Oceania represents an extraordinarily smart luxury value.

savingsTips.title: How to Avoid Unexpected Expenses on an Oceania Cruise
savingsTips.subtitle: Six Essential Recommendations from Luxury Cruise Travel Advisors

steps.title: Review Your Booking Confirmation
steps.description: Verify your specific fare code and confirmation to confirm which Your World Included amenity (wine/beer or excursion credit) is attached to your stateroom.

steps.title: Select the Right Choice Amenity
steps.description: If you enjoy wine with lunch and dinner, the beverage amenity provides substantial daily value. If you prefer guided tours, choose the shore excursion credit.

steps.title: Evaluate Your Beverage Consumption
steps.description: If you regularly drink cocktails, martinis, or spirits outside dining hours, price out the upgraded Prestige Beverage Package in advance to save on a la carte pricing.

steps.title: Book Excursions at Least 14 Days Ahead
steps.description: When applying your shore excursion credit, secure your tours early through Oceania's portal or your advisor, as popular boutique excursions have strict capacity limits.

steps.title: Understand Wi-Fi Streaming Limits
steps.description: Standard Wi-Fi is ideal for browsing, messages, and email. If you need Netflix streaming or high-bandwidth video conferencing, budget for the streaming upgrade.

steps.title: Plan for Pre-Cruise Travel & Insurance
steps.description: Protect your cruise investment by budgeting for a pre-cruise hotel night (avoiding flight delays) and comprehensive travel insurance covering emergency medical evacuation.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About What's Included on Oceania Cruises
faqs.subtitle: Essential answers on dining, drinks, internet, tipping, excursions, and extras.

questions.question: What is included in an Oceania cruise fare?
questions.answer: Oceania's Your World Included program covers specialty dining, shipboard gratuities for covered service teams, Wi-Fi, selected nonalcoholic beverages, in-suite and in-stateroom dining, selected group fitness classes, and laundry-related benefits. Guests can also choose between complimentary wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours or a shore excursion credit.

questions.question: Are all meals included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Most regular onboard dining is included, including main dining venues, specialty restaurants, and in-room dining selections. Certain premium culinary experiences or separately priced events may cost extra.

questions.question: Are drinks free on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Selected nonalcoholic beverages, including sodas, specialty coffees and teas, Vero Water, juices, smoothies, and gourmet ice cream, are included. Guests can also choose selected wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours. Premium alcoholic beverages may cost extra.

questions.question: Is alcohol included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Selected wine and beer are included if guests choose the beverage amenity. Cocktails, spirits, premium wines, and drinks outside the applicable selection or hours may require an additional purchase.

questions.question: Are gratuities included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Current eligible Your World Included bookings cover standard gratuities for stateroom and suite attendants, butlers where applicable, and dining waitstaff. A 20% service gratuity may still apply to certain additional purchases, such as beverages and spa services.

questions.question: Is Wi-Fi free on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Standard Wi-Fi is included, with complimentary logins for the first two devices per stateroom or suite under the published terms. Streaming upgrades and additional logins may cost extra.

questions.question: Is specialty dining included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Regular specialty restaurants are included in the cruise fare under Your World Included. Restaurant selection depends on the ship, and certain special culinary experiences may be separately priced.

questions.question: Are shore excursions included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Guests can choose a shore excursion credit instead of the wine-and-beer amenity. The credit amount depends on voyage length and is subject to the promotional terms. Excursions costing more than the available credit require additional payment.

questions.question: Is laundry free on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Oceania provides complimentary self-service launderettes. Full-service laundry and pressing benefits depend on the accommodation category. Concierge Level and suite guests receive specified additional laundry privileges subject to limits.

questions.question: Are spa treatments included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: No. Massages, facials, salon appointments, and many other spa services generally cost extra. Selected group fitness classes are included, and certain accommodation categories receive additional spa-related privileges.

questions.question: Are flights included in Oceania cruise fares?
questions.answer: Flights are not automatically included in every booking. Some voyages may have an applicable airfare program or promotional offer. Check the specific reservation for flight and transfer details.

questions.question: Does Oceania include pre-cruise and post-cruise hotels?
questions.answer: Hotel stays are generally separate unless included in a specific package or promotion. Travelers should check their booking details before arranging accommodation.

questions.question: What is the difference between wine and beer and shore excursion credit?
questions.answer: They are alternative Your World Included amenities. Guests can select wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours or choose a shore excursion credit based on voyage length. Selecting one means the other is not included under the same choice offer.

questions.question: Is Oceania Cruises truly all-inclusive?
questions.answer: Oceania includes many onboard essentials, but not every possible expense. Premium drinks, spa treatments, some excursions, streaming upgrades, travel arrangements, and personal purchases may cost extra. It is best described as an inclusive luxury cruise experience rather than an entirely all-inclusive package.

questions.question: How can I find out exactly what is included in my Oceania booking?
questions.answer: Review the booking confirmation, fare conditions, and applicable Your World Included promotional terms. Check the selected amenity, accommodation benefits, Wi-Fi conditions, and any air or hotel arrangements. A luxury cruise travel advisor can help compare the complete inclusions before you book.
